kill_switch.description: true = app disables itself and shows kill_message. Reversible.

defaultValue.value: We're fixing something — back soon. Thanks for your patience! ⚽

kill_message.description: Shown in the blocking window when kill_switch is on.

min_build.description: Builds below this are blocked behind a forced Sparkle update.

latest_build.description: Newest published build. Builds below this get a soft 'Update available' banner atop the menu (not blocked). 0 = no banner.

celebration_enabled.description: false = hide tap-to-support and stop sending /celebrate (cost kill switch).

poll_seconds.description: Live-score poll interval (matches the matches/*.json TTL). App adds ±15% jitter.

celebration_sample_percent.description: Client reporter probability + server multiply-back factor. Must equal CELEBRATION_SAMPLE_RATE on the backend. 1.0 = everyone reports (exact, no sampling).

animation_params.description: Tune animation feel without shipping a build.

max_fan_teams.description: Max teams a user can be a fan of. Raise without shipping a build. Starts at 10.

remote_config_fetch_interval_seconds.description: Periodic fetch interval in seconds. Range: 60–86400; default: 300. Startup and foreground fetch immediately. Lower values increase billable fetches.

event_stale_minutes.description: VAR-only staleness tolerance in minutes. Late VAR decisions beyond this threshold are suppressed; goals, cards, and substitutions are not.
